messages:
From: Samir Gupta <samir@edgeware.com>
To: alex_martinez@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Model run stalls mid-generation

Hi Alex,

We're seeing the model stall consistently at ~120 tokens for one of our production prompts. The client request starts, CPU and network look fine on our side, then the generation halts and the client eventually times out. We've attached a screenshot of the UI hang and a segment of our client logs. This started around 08:50 PT and affects only one of our two regions.

Key details:
- Model: open-llama-13b (via Redwood hosted)
- Request id shown in our logs: req_9b2f3e
- Approx token when stall occurs: 118-123
- We don't see any HTTP 5xx from Redwood on our side; request finally returns "connection reset" after client timeout.

Can you take a look? This is impacting our nightly job. Happy to jump on a call.

Thanks,
Samir
Senior Platform Engineer, EdgeWare

Attachments: screenshot-20270605.png (image/png), client-log-20270605.txt (text/plain)

I've looped in Monica and Rishi from the ops team to help reproduce and pull internal traces. We'll aim to respond with initial findings within 2 hours. If you'd prefer a quick screenshare, I'm available at 10:00 PT.

– Alex

Reply (internal):
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: alex_martinez@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-05T10:10:00-07:00

Quick update: I pulled matching-time window traces for their account and request window. No server-side 5xx, no backlog spikes, and our runtime shows the request completed (token stream finished) on our edge at 08:50:12 PT, and we see a normal TCP FIN. There is a client-side 499-ish termination pattern in the logs (client closed before completing retrieval).

Attaching internal trace: redwood-debug-trace-20270605.json

Suggest asking the customer to confirm SDK timeout and whether a proxy/loadbalancer in their stack might be terminating idle reads. Will coordinate if they want a joint debug call.

From: alex_martinez@redwood.ai
To: Samir Gupta <samir@edgeware.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, EdgeWare Support <support@edgeware.com>
Date: 2027-06-06T11:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Model run stalls mid-generation — outcome and recommended next steps

Hi Samir — thanks for your patience while we investigated. Summary of findings:

- We pulled the request traces for the time window you reported (08:50 PT). Our runtime shows the model completed generation for req_9b2f3e and streamed tokens to the edge; we do not see any platform-side error or retry. The internal trace we've attached indicates normal completion and a TCP FIN from the client side.
- In your client logs we see a socket closed on client side shortly after the last token arrived (consistent with a client timeout or a proxy idle timeout).

Outcome: No evidence of a Redwood platform fault. Most likely root cause is client-side or infra between your app and the Redwood edge (SDK timeout, proxy LB idle timeout, or client-side retry logic).

Recommended next steps:
1) Confirm the SDK version and increase the request read timeout to 60s while testing (see our debug guide).
2) If you have a proxy/load balancer (NGINX/Envoy/F5), check idle/read timeout settings and any connection resets around 08:50 PT.
3) If you'd like, we can run a joint reproducer: share a redacted prompt and a curl+payload snippet, and Rishi will run synchronous reproductions while you tail client logs.

Links: Debug guide — https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-debug-trace, Support ticket — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-789

We're closing this support ticket on the Redwood side (SUP-789) for now as no platform action is required; please reopen if you observe server-side 5xx or if you want the joint reproducer session.

Best,
